title: Optimal Encoding
statementMd:
Touko's favorite sequence of numbers is a permutation $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ of $1, 2, \dots, n$, and she wants some collection of permutations that are similar to her favorite permutation.

She has a collection of $q$ intervals of the form $[l_i, r_i]$ with $1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$. To create permutations that are similar to her favorite permutation, she coined the following definition:

- A permutation $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ allows an interval $[l', r']$ to *holds its shape* if for any pair of integers $(x, y)$ such that $l' \le x \lt y \le r'$, we have $b_x \lt b_y$ if and only if $a_x \lt a_y$.
- A permutation $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ is *$k$-similar* if $b$ allows all intervals $[l_i, r_i]$ for all $1 \le i \le k$ to hold their shapes.

Yuu wants to figure out all $k$-similar permutations for Touko, but it turns out this is a very hard task; instead, Yuu will *encode* the set of all $k$-similar permutations with directed acylic graphs (DAG). Yuu also coined the following definitions for herself:

- A permutation $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ *satisfies* a DAG $G'$ if for all edge $u \to v$ in $G'$, we must have $b_u \lt b_v$.
- A *$k$-encoding* is a DAG $G_k$ on the set of vertices $1, 2, \dots, n$ such that a permutation $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ satisfies $G_k$ if and only if $b$ is $k$-similar.

Since Yuu is free today, she wants to figure out the minimum number of edges among all $k$-encodings for each $k$ from $1$ to $q$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $n$ and $q$ ($1 \le n \le 25\,000$, $1 \le q \le 100\,000$).

The second line contains $n$ integers $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$ which form a permutation of $1, 2, \dots, n$.

The $i$-th of the following $q$ lines contains two integers $l_i$ and $r_i$. ($1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$).

## Output

Print $q$ lines. The $k$-th of them should contain a single integer  — The minimum number of edges among all $k$-encodings.

## Note

For the first test case:

- All $1$-similar permutations must allow the interval $[1, 3]$ to hold its shape. Therefore, the set of all $1$-similar permutations is $\{[3, 4, 2, 1], [3, 4, 1, 2], [2, 4, 1, 3], [2, 3, 1, 4]\}$. The optimal encoding of these permutations is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4128a6ff787335449766547609bb326400871a85.png)
- All $2$-similar permutations must allow the intervals $[1, 3]$ and $[2, 4]$ to hold their shapes. Therefore, the set of all $2$-similar permutations is $\{[3, 4, 1, 2], [2, 4, 1, 3]\}$. The optimal encoding of these permutations is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8b9494b69f5e6f0f16127113d05109b1cb5c7fa.png)
- All $3$-similar permutations must allow the intervals $[1, 3]$, $[2, 4]$, and $[1, 4]$ to hold their shapes. Therefore, the set of all $3$-similar permutations only includes $[2, 4, 1, 3]$. The optimal encoding of this permutation is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22b16d291f6811e7dcdc4c9b7486ffe65cf52f6f.png)
statementZhMd:
Touko 最喜欢的数字序列是一个由 $1, 2, \dots, n$ 组成的排列 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$，她想要找出一些与她最喜欢的排列相似的排列。

她有一个包含 $q$ 个区间的集合，区间形式为 $[l_i, r_i]$，其中 $1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$。为了构造与她最喜欢的排列相似的排列，她提出了如下定义：

- 如果对于任意满足 $l' \le x \lt y \le r'$ 的整数对 $(x, y)$，都有当且仅当 $a_x \lt a_y$ 时 $b_x \lt b_y$，则称排列 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ 使区间 $[l', r']$ *保持其形状*。
- 如果排列 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ 使所有 $1 \le i \le k$ 的区间 $[l_i, r_i]$ 都保持其形状，则称排列 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ 是一个 *$k$-相似*排列。

Yuu 想找出 Touko 的所有 $k$-相似排列，但事实证明这是一项非常困难的任务；因此，Yuu 将使用有向无环图（DAG）来*编码*所有 $k$-相似排列的集合。Yuu 还为自己提出了如下定义：

- 如果对于 $G'$ 中的每条边 $u \to v$，都有 $b_u \lt b_v$，则称排列 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ *满足* DAG $G'$。
- 一个 *$k$-编码*是一个顶点集合为 $1, 2, \dots, n$ 的 DAG $G_k$，使得排列 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ 满足 $G_k$ 当且仅当 $b$ 是 $k$-相似排列。

由于今天有空，Yuu 想求出对于每个从 $1$ 到 $q$ 的 $k$，所有 $k$-编码中边数的最小值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $n$ 和 $q$（$1 \le n \le 25\,000$，$1 \le q \le 100\,000$）。

第二行包含 $n$ 个整数 $a_1, a_2, \dots, a_n$，它们构成一个由 $1, 2, \dots, n$ 组成的排列。

接下来的 $q$ 行中，第 $i$ 行包含两个整数 $l_i$ 和 $r_i$。（$1 \le l_i \le r_i \le n$。）

## 输出格式

输出 $q$ 行。第 $k$ 行应包含一个整数——所有 $k$-编码中边数的最小值。

## 说明

对于第一个测试用例：

- 所有 $1$-相似排列都必须使区间 $[1, 3]$ 保持其形状。因此，所有 $1$-相似排列的集合为 $\{[3, 4, 2, 1], [3, 4, 1, 2], [2, 4, 1, 3], [2, 3, 1, 4]\}$。这些排列的最优编码为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4128a6ff787335449766547609bb326400871a85.png)
- 所有 $2$-相似排列都必须使区间 $[1, 3]$ 和 $[2, 4]$ 保持其形状。因此，所有 $2$-相似排列的集合为 $\{[3, 4, 1, 2], [2, 4, 1, 3]\}$。这些排列的最优编码为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f8b9494b69f5e6f0f16127113d05109b1cb5c7fa.png)
- 所有 $3$-相似排列都必须使区间 $[1, 3]$、$[2, 4]$ 和 $[1, 4]$ 保持其形状。因此，所有 $3$-相似排列中仅包含 $[2, 4, 1, 3]$。这个排列的最优编码为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22b16d291f6811e7dcdc4c9b7486ffe65cf52f6f.png)
